en.title: HuggingFace Model: openai-community/gpt2
en.hook: The foundational 124M parameter decoder-only Transformer model that established modern autoregressive text generation.
key_takeaways: Base GPT-2 (Small) language model originally developed by OpenAI and maintained by the Hugging Face community.
Generates over 14 million downloads monthly, serving as a classic standard baseline across NLP research.
Ideal lightweight model for text generation tasks, local experimentation, fine-tuning tutorials, and benchmarking.
